We made a grand start by having both our men in the final of the 100 yards, and " Ginger " Holtum surprised many by beating Clay Gibbs to win in 10.5 seconds.
Alan Sexton and Dicky Bartlett also qualified for the 220 final and Alan set up a new "meet" record with a time of 22.7, beating Clay Gibbs with Dicky scoring a point for his 6th place.
